prompts.label: A / SOFT
prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Input image: reference for the user-selected Caramel identity direction for "flan36", not a request to change to a new brand.
Create ONE refined variant design board for this same identity. Preserve its recognizable low rounded tapered flan pudding silhouette, single caramel drip, understated rounded lowercase "flan36" wordmark, and warm caramel/custard palette. Typography must read exactly flan36, without any altered letters or numbers.
Square presentation on a fully opaque warm ivory background edge to edge. Crisp flat vector-like artwork, no gradients, shading, gloss, texture, 3D objects, mockups or shadows. This time focus entirely on the logo. No split emblem, no pixels, no face, no spoon, no plate, no decorative circuitry.
Top: small variant label. Center: one generously sized two-color icon above the wordmark. Bottom: the exact same icon and wordmark rendered as black single-ink artwork on ivory on the left and ivory on a solid dark charcoal square on the right. Keep geometry identical across those applications; use thick clear negative space to separate caramel and custard when monochrome. Lots of clean whitespace. No other text.
Variant direction: Refine the original gently: retain the asymmetric caramel drip near the right edge, shorten it slightly and give it a beautifully round end. Subtle rounding at the shoulders, a flatter underside, and a small shallow ellipse for the top. A premium, quiet and highly legible version, closest to the reference. Maintain the generous, soft lowercase wordmark.
Exact text only: "A / SOFT", "flan36".
